name: scene_view
description: Control and inspect Creator scene viewport state in one compact operation: gizmo tool/pivot/coordinate, 2D/3D mode, grid, icon gizmo, focus and align. These settings affect the editor viewport, not saved game content.

name: reference_image
description: Manage Creator reference-image overlays with bounded path validation and native readback. Images are external design files, not project assets; configure position/scale/opacity and inspect or clear the current scene overlay.

name: font_inspect
description: Load an imported Font through the installed engine. Report TTF/bitmap kind, bitmap texture/glyphs and optional missing character sample. TTF/system glyph coverage and fallback remain unknown; loaded is not visual verification.

name: text_inspect
description: Inspect existing Label/RichText, observed font/actual shrink size and text preview. Does not force layout or modify render data. includeText returns full source; use ui.measure and runtime screenshot for geometry/display.

name: text_configure
description: Configure an existing Label/RichText using semantic enums and system or imported font. Uses native typed component.patch with undo/readback/recovery. RichText requires TTF; bitmap fonts work with Label. RichText inline styles use markup. No component is added, no save; dryRun validates only.

name: ui_measure
description: Measure project UITransform own rectangle corners and AABB in nearest Canvas local coordinates; includes camera/layer and observed Label/RichText state. UUID/path/unique name; bounded subtree optional. Not screen pixels, glyph ink, occlusion or hit-test proof.

name: ui_validate
description: Diagnose project UI rectangles and typography with rule IDs/evidence: zero size, missing Canvas, camera/layer, Canvas overflow, missing font, small actual text and missing bitmap glyphs. Optional potential button AABB overlap is informational, not occlusion proof. No auto-fix; budgets/truncation explicit. Omitting node scans project scene.

name: ui_layout
description: Configure UI adaptation components through semantic fields with typed enum conversion and native readback. Supports Widget anchors, Layout flow/grid, ScrollView content/axes, Mask, SafeArea and BlockInputEvents. ensure adds a missing component; configure can dry-run; remove verifies absence. Node references accept UUID/path strings and are checked before edits.

name: asset_info
description: Read compact imported asset identity, source SHA256, subassets, direct dependencies/users. Uses native AssetDB; source hashing limited to 16 MiB.

name: asset_graph
description: Read bounded native AssetDB dependency/user graph. Cached edges expire after 1.5s and invalidate on asset broadcasts. Budget/depth limits are explicit; dynamic string loads are outside this index. Both directions can reach unrelated shared users; prefer dependencies for build impact.

name: asset_import
description: Import a local absolute file/folder via native AssetDB without overwrite/rename. Includes binary assets and normal importer/meta behavior. dryRun prechecks source/destination only.

name: asset_move
description: Native AssetDB move of a project source file. Requires current SHA256 expectedRevision; refuses overwrite, dirty current scene, folders/subassets/internal assets. Move verifies main/subasset UUID preservation; copy verifies a fresh main UUID. Runtime string paths still need review.

name: asset_copy
description: Native AssetDB copy of a project source file. Requires current SHA256 expectedRevision; refuses overwrite, dirty current scene, folders/subassets/internal assets. Move verifies main/subasset UUID preservation; copy verifies a fresh main UUID. Runtime string paths still need review.

name: asset_reimport
description: Reimport a project source file with expectedRevision and clean editor context; verify native UUID/URL after import.

name: asset_replace_plan
description: Plan exact serialized __uuid__ replacements across native direct users of one asset, requiring same imported type. Read-only to project assets. Returns planId, affected fields and unsupported users; unsupported users block apply. Excludes script class migrations and dynamic paths. Plans expire after 5 minutes/reload.

name: asset_replace_apply
description: Apply a replacement plan once: recheck source hashes/users, create local backups, native AssetDB save and exact source readback. On failure best-effort restore only unchanged attempted writes, report incomplete recovery. Non-atomic across scene/runtime state; reopen affected scenes and verify.

name: asset_restore
description: Restore source backups from asset replacement or animation editing. Requires clean scene and exact post-write hashes; refuses stale/tampered/moved assets. Backups current source before restoring through AssetDB; does not overwrite meta. Non-atomic across files.

name: animation_create
description: Create a native serialized .anim using installed engine track APIs: scalar/vector/color/size/quaternion/object channels, linear/constant/cubic keys and component event methods. Strict sorted times; object asset references resolved before save. No overwrite; dryRun does not save. Binding and runtime playback are separate.

name: animation_edit
description: Edit a project .anim source with expectedRevision and backup. Metadata patch preserves tracks/events unless supplied; supplied arrays replace the entire track/event list. Native deserialize resolves asset refs, checks duration and reserializes. Model-imported clips are excluded. Restore with asset.restore.

name: animation_inspect
description: Read a project .anim source through engine deserialization: revision, tracks/channel counts, path and events. keys=true includes full key values; avoid it unless needed.

name: animation_sample
description: Evaluate native clip curves at a time without modifying scene nodes. Returns per-channel samples, not proof of target binding/gameplay. Use animation.control and runtime.inspect in the preview for runtime verification.

name: animation_bind
description: Attach/reuse cc.Animation and bind an existing .anim, preserving existing clips. Optionally set default clip and playOnLoad. Native typed edits; save scene explicitly. This does not verify all animated target paths or business event handlers.

name: runtime_inspect
description: Read actual game node state in an MCP-owned preview/build window: transforms, UI size/anchor, Label/RichText font bindings and actual shrink size, Animation states, Spine tracks/bones and retained adapter events. Requires engine ready; exact runtime path/UUID or unique name. Runtime UUIDs differ from editor UUIDs. Event subscriptions start when using control operations.

name: animation_control
description: Control cc.Animation in an MCP-owned running game window: play/pause/resume/stop/crossFade/sample. Runtime only, never saves editor content. sample pauses chosen/default state, sets time and samples actual targets. Inspect afterward to verify.

name: spine_inspect
description: Load imported sp.SkeletonData using installed engine runtime. Read runtime/source version compatibility, parse success, animations, skins, bones, slots/events and direct textures. Binary null compatibility is not a positive version check.

name: spine_configure
description: Attach/reuse sp.Skeleton and bind a parsed compatible imported skeleton, validated skin/animation, loop and timeScale via typed native properties. Save scene explicitly. Not a skeleton authoring/exporter tool.

name: spine_control
description: Control actual Spine runtime in an MCP-owned preview/build: play/queue tracks, skin, mix, clear, pause/resume. Validates animation/skin names. Retains bounded per-track complete/custom event observations without replacing global gameplay listeners. Changes are runtime only.

name: build_platforms
description: List installed Creator build platforms. Dedicated validated task/artifact/preview workflow currently targets Web desktop/mobile; native platforms still require SDK/toolchain-specific acceptance.

name: build_start
description: Queue a native Web build of explicit saved project scenes. Requires clean editor and no running build. Uses unique output under project build/cocos-mcp; returns durable runId, not completion. Poll status, inspect logs/artifacts and launch built game. dryRun validates inputs only.

name: build_status
description: Read an owned build run by persistent runId and correlate unique native task. Reports native waiting/processing/success/failure/cancel, progress and bounded message. Unknown is not success; accepted/start is not completion.

name: build_artifacts
description: Require native terminal success, inventory owned Web output and verify nonempty index/JS. Optional per-file SHA256; bounded result. Files existing alone are not gameplay verification; use build.preview and runtime checks.

name: build_logs
description: Read bounded native build log tail for an owned run. Last 128 KiB, optional substring filter and line limit. No arbitrary filesystem path access.

name: build_preview
description: Verify successful owned build, serve only its artifacts on loopback and open in a sandboxed MCP game window. Reuses owned preview. Loaded does not prove game-ready; inspect runtime, console and screenshot. Server stops on extension unload or build.stopServer.

name: build_stop_server
description: Stop only this owned build static server. Preserve build files/native task; preview window can be closed separately.

name: prefab_inspect
description: Inspect a project subtree/instance: actual prefab root, asset SHA256 revision, dependencies and external Node/Component references. Use UUIDs returned by prefab.open in prefab editing mode.

name: prefab_validate
description: Validate a project prefab source: serialized object references, AssetDB dependencies and registered classes. Returns SHA256 revision needed by apply/save/restore. Does not prove visual or runtime correctness.

name: prefab_create
description: Create a linked prefab using Creator native serialization. Refuses overwrite, existing prefab membership and incoming/outgoing external Node/Component references. Creator REPLACES the subtree with new UUIDs and filename; use returned node UUID and resolve descendants again. dryRun prechecks only. Save scene explicitly.

name: prefab_instantiate
description: Instantiate an imported project prefab and verify linkage. parent accepts UUID/path/name; explicit content parent required in prefab mode. Returns node UUID. Save scene explicitly.

name: prefab_apply
description: Apply a linked instance ROOT to its shared prefab asset with native Creator API. Refuses external refs and stale expectedRevision from inspect/validate. Saves local recoverable backup before writing. Affects other instances; scene save is explicit. dryRun does not write.

name: prefab_revert
description: Restore a linked instance ROOT from its prefab asset using native undo-aware restore. Discards instance overrides; does not modify the asset. Save scene explicitly.

name: prefab_unlink
description: Unlink a linked instance ROOT using native undo-aware API. recursive=false preserves nested prefab links; true unlinks nested instances too. Does not delete the asset. Save scene explicitly.

name: prefab_open
description: Enter native prefab editing mode. Refuses unsaved current edits; returns real content root UUID, asset revision and returnAsset. Edit through normal node/component tools, then prefab.save and prefab.close.

name: prefab_save
description: Save current native prefab editing context. Requires expectedRevision from open/validate, checks external refs, creates local backup, verifies serialized asset and clean dirty state. This writes a shared asset.

name: prefab_close
description: Leave prefab editing mode for explicit returnAsset UUID/URL returned by prefab.open. Refuses unsaved edits; never discards or silently saves.

name: prefab_restore
description: Restore a prefab backup created by apply/save/restore through AssetDB, preserving .meta. Requires clean current context and expectedRevision; backs up current content first. backupId is project-local and bound to this exact asset. Reopen scene to verify instance sync.

name: preview_open
description: Open/reload this project local Web preview in a dedicated sandboxed Electron window controlled by editor.screenshot and editor.input. Requires a saved scene. Reuses its own preview window. Loaded is not game-ready; inspect screenshot/runtime evidence. testEvidence adds mcp-test=1 for the bundled demo only.

name: preview_close
description: Close only a dedicated preview window created by preview.open. Does not close Creator editor windows or external browsers.

name: preview_status
description: Read a dedicated MCP preview window: load state, canvas bounds, bounded browser console logs and optional bundled-demo test evidence. DOM/canvas readiness is not proof of working gameplay. Use screenshot and real input. since filters retained logs by timestamp in ms.

name: node_resolve
description: Resolve a project node by UUID, exact Canvas/Panel path or unique name. Rejects ambiguous names and editor helper nodes. Returns a compact identity and component list.

name: component_properties
description: Read plain component properties and types without full inspector metadata. node accepts UUID/path/unique name; component accepts registered type or component UUID. Use names to return only needed fields.

name: component_patch
description: Set 1–40 public top-level component properties using plain values and installed inspector types. References: {$node:"Canvas/Panel"}, {$component:{node:"path",type:"cc.Label"}}, {$asset:"db://assets/..."}, {uuid:"..."}, null to clear. Checks all fields/references before edits; one undo group, readback and best-effort restoration on error. Not a whole-scene transaction. dryRun makes no edits.

name: script_status
description: Check whether a Component ccclass is registered in the scene. Optional asset URL/UUID verifies script ownership. This does not run full TypeScript type checking or prove latest source hot-reloaded.

name: script_attach
description: Wait for a project script ccclass to register, verify ownership against required asset URL/UUID, then attach once through native messages. Existing component is reused. Write scripts with asset.write first. Timeout never adds a component; inspect editor.logs. Saves are explicit. Registration does not prove latest hot-reloaded code or TS type correctness.

name: button_events
description: Configure Button click events through typed native property dumps. Resolve target by UUID/path/name, verify target component and handler. replace sets exact list; append skips identical events; remove uses zero-based index; clear removes all. dryRun validates without edits. Readback does not replace runtime click testing.

name: ui_templates
description: List built-in UI templates and their intended parent. Templates are source-controlled and can be inspected without editing.

name: ui_build
description: Build UI through native undo-aware messages in the project hierarchy, excluding editor helper Canvases. Supply tree or template. Defaults to the sole active project Canvas; creates a Canvas and UI camera if absent unless createCanvas=false. An explicit parent must be inside a project Canvas. Multiple Canvases require parent. Checks hierarchy membership and camera; use dryRun first. Failure cleans up only this build.

name: scene_snapshot
description: Capture a bounded scene snapshot in editor memory (max 8); returns its id and node count. Snapshots contain structure, transforms, UI size and label text, not a complete scene serialization. Not an undo backup.

name: scene_diff
description: Compare a saved snapshot to the current scene; reports added/removed/changed nodes. IDs expire on extension reload. Checks structural and selected UI properties only.

name: scene_validate
description: Check scene for duplicate sibling names and zero-size UI transforms. Bounded structural/UI diagnostics; does not claim comprehensive asset-reference or visual validation.

name: knowledge_query
description: Search bundled practical guidance for UI, undo, prefabs, animation, assets, debugging and build workflows. Results distinguish implemented tools from workflow advice.

name: editor_status
description: Check bridge connection, actual Creator version and configured project. Does not require the scene to be ready.

name: editor_operation_status
description: Inspect a timed-out request by requestId. Completed means the handler returned; verify resulting editor state. History holds up to 200 operations.

name: editor_events
description: Read recent bridge operation events and scene/save/compile/build broadcasts. This is not the complete Creator console. Use after=latest to poll incrementally.

name: editor_logs
description: Read Creator console logs (including errors and compilation messages) via Editor.Logger.query. Filter by level, message substring, or since timestamp in milliseconds. Returns the latest matching entries.

name: editor_api
description: Read actual installed Creator/engine TypeScript declarations to discover precise parameters before invoking advanced APIs. source=message/types requires package; editor is Editor API; engine is project cc.d.ts. Search returns matching line numbers, then use startLine to read context.

name: editor_messages
description: Discover installed editor/extension messages with localized documentation and examples. Filter by package, e.g. scene, asset-db, builder, preview, animation. Private messages may change between Creator versions.

name: editor_request
description: Invoke any installed Creator message. Discover its exact arguments with editor_messages first. request awaits its handler; send only acknowledges dispatch and can trigger UI operations without a reply.

name: editor_script
description: Run an async JavaScript function body in the editor main process (Editor, require, args) or scene process (cc, Editor, require, args). Full local trust, no sandbox. Explicitly return plain JSON; never return engine/native objects. Direct scene engine mutations may bypass undo/dirty tracking; prefer native messages, then verify and save.

name: scene_tree
description: Read the open scene node hierarchy, optionally rooted at uuid. Query object dumps with node_inspect before setting properties.

name: scene_open
description: Open an existing .scene asset by db:// URL or asset UUID. Refuses if current scene has unsaved edits.

name: scene_save
description: Save the current scene and check its dirty state. Untitled scenes may require a Save As dialog; prefer opening an existing scene first.

name: node_inspect
description: Get the full Creator inspector dump for a node or component. Use dump types/paths to update properties.

name: node_create
description: Create an undoable node, or instantiate a prefab/built-in asset via assetUuid. Returns the new node UUID.

name: node_remove
description: Delete the specified scene nodes using the editor.

name: node_duplicate
description: Duplicate scene nodes using Creator.

name: node_reparent
description: Move scene nodes under a parent, optionally preserving world transforms.

name: property_set
description: Set one inspector property through Creator with undo recording. Provide a dump using the actual type and new value from node_inspect, e.g. {type:"String",value:"Player"}. Node paths include name, position, rotation, scale; component paths are relative to its UUID.

name: component_add
description: Add a registered component (e.g. cc.Label, cc.Sprite, cc.RigidBody2D or a project ccclass) to a node; return its updated dump.

name: component_remove
description: Remove a component by its component UUID.

name: editor_selection
description: Get selection, or set it when uuids is supplied. type is node or asset. An empty uuids array clears selection.

name: asset_query
description: Search the Creator asset database. Example pattern db://assets/**/*.scene and type cc.SceneAsset. Results are paginated.

name: asset_write
description: Create or save a text asset/script using Creator AssetDB, preserving meta/import behavior. Create refuses existing assets; save requires an existing asset. Use editor_request for import/copy/move/delete/reimport or binary assets.

name: project_read
description: Read a UTF-8 project file up to 1 MiB. Paths must remain inside the project after resolving symlinks. For assets write through asset_write.

name: project_files
description: List a project directory, excluding generated/dependency directories.

name: editor_panel
description: Open an editor panel by registered name, e.g. inspector, assets, console, builder. Verify using screenshot.

name: editor_windows
description: List Electron windows owned by this Creator instance, IDs and content bounds in DIP coordinates.

name: editor_window
description: Focus/show/restore, maximize or minimize a Creator window. Focus a minimized window before screenshot or input.

name: editor_screenshot
description: Capture a Creator Electron window as PNG. Metadata includes originalSize, imageSize and contentBounds. Map image coordinates to content DIP: x * contentBounds.width / imageSize.width (and similarly y). Native scene surfaces can appear blank on some GPU configurations.

name: editor_input
description: Send input to an observed Creator window. Coordinates are content-local DIP, not desktop pixels. For a click send mouseDown and mouseUp; use mouseMove sequences for drag. text inserts Unicode at focus. This cannot control OS-native dialogs or external apps. Re-capture to verify.

name: editor_menu
description: List the actual application menu, or dispatch a leaf item using its numeric path from that list, e.g. [1,0]. Verify the resulting state separately.
